values.note: 2026 nightly for 2 adults and minor children: 30-amp electric only $34, 30-amp water and electric $37, 50-amp electric only $38, 50-amp water and electric $41; tent $32. Weekly and some monthly rates; extra adults $5 a day (4 adults at most). Yearly seasonal site $1,350 (camping May 1 - October 15, metered electric).

values.note: Modern bath house with complimentary hot showers; snack bar and store (LP gas, RV supplies, groceries, firewood); dump station ($15 for non-registered guests); free Wi-Fi.

facilities.source: https://www.miopineacrescampground.com/index.php ('FREE WI-FI', 'Clean, Modern Bath House (w/complimentary hot showers for our guests)', 'Laundry Room', 'Snack Bar / Store') + contactus.php (facility icons 'Flush Toilets', 'Showers', 'Laundry', 'Store') + rates.php ('Dump Station (non-registered guest) $15'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve with the office (989-826-5590 or 800-289-2845). Cancellations 31+ days out are refunded less $10; within 30 days the deposit is lost; no refunds on holiday weekends. Check-out noon.

note: Family-run campground and cabins at 1215 W 8th St (M-72), about a mile west of Mio and a mile from the Au Sable River (not on it); mini-golf, rental bikes, pizza, an ORV staging area with trail access. No UTVs, ATVs or golf carts may be ridden in the park. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site (miopineacres.com now redirects to miopineacrescampground.com): 2026 $34 (30-amp electric only) to $41 (50-amp W/E), open Apr 15 - Nov 1, 50-amp with water, pull-throughs, laundry/store/dump, Passport America, phone 989-826-5590. Changed season (was open/close unknown) to 04-15/11-01; added fees, showers, flush toilets, wifi, phone booking and policies. Cleared derived 75-site count and 45-ft max (map numbers sites to 100; no length stated). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Website miopineacres.com now redirects to https://www.miopineacrescampground.com/ (live, 2026 rates). The operator's contact page still lists miopineacres.com, so the entry's URL works either way.

Seasonal share not stated: the park sells yearly seasonal sites ($1,350) but its site map does not mark them; it posts 2026 nightly rates for every RV site type, so it reads as an ordinary transient park. Price under US$50; no gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here.
